questions.q: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂. (a) Calculate the mass of CaO from 25 g CaCO₃. (b) 11.2 g is collected; calculate % yield. (c) Give two reasons it is below 100%.
questions.a: (a) 0.25 mol × 56 = 14 g (3 marks); (b) 11.2 ÷ 14 × 100 = 80% (1); (c) incomplete decomposition; loss in transfer (2).
questions.model: Teacher works (a): moles CaCO₃ = 25 ÷ 100 = 0.25; ratio 1:1; mass CaO = 0.25 × 56 = 14 g.
